items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: That's another man my father used to play with. He knows my daddy well.

ctx.x: Piku still plays. Yes, that's right. He's over 80.
That's another man my father used to play with. He knows my daddy well.
Yes, I think he's mentioned him when we talked to him. I'm quite sure he talked to him.
